feed.title: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugins — Curated List · Awesome DSH Plugin

entry.title: Han-1413141/dsh-ui-hub
entry.summary: Search, show, hide, move, resize and arrange plugin controls in DSH Desktop and Web, with layout backup, restore and undo.

entry.title: weibaohui/dsh-dashboard
entry.summary: Usage dashboard: offline-scans session logs to chart daily/weekly/monthly tokens, estimated costs, model/tool/skill/command leaderboards, output speed, working hours and quality metrics; gridstack+ECharts cards are drag-and-drop composable, with custom formulas and AI arrangement (prompt round-trip import).

entry.title: lamost423/dsh-maze
entry.summary: Execution maze for DSH sessions: main path, detours and backtracks on one timeline with per-step data tracks (tools, tokens, context pressure), deterministic analysis (outcome evidence, behavior signals) and comparison of up to five sessions; reads session logs and renders live inside a session tab.

entry.title: fengchang618gmail/dsh-course-subtitles
entry.summary: Fetch course video captions (DeepLearning.AI / YouTube / Bilibili / Coursera), merge them into whole sentences, translate line by line (EN/ZH) and generate bilingual section headings, then publish one Feishu doc per lesson; also exports a course home page outline into a single doc. All credentials are read from the environment or the harness credential store.

entry.title: Han-1413141/dsh-codex-computer-use
entry.summary: Let a DSH model inspect and operate Windows applications through an installed Codex Computer Use runtime, with per-session app approval.

entry.title: luobosibing2/dsh-jev-plugin
entry.summary: Integrates TypeSafe Jev for skill and file selection, task supervision, shared-finding corrections, tool-output filtering, approval assistance, and recorded-stage navigation in DeepSeek Harness; all features are disabled by default.

entry.title: moguiyu/dsh-tavily
entry.summary: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per Tavily account; a key and usage card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced.

entry.title: PriceDotWin/pricewin-dsh
entry.summary: Live hotel and flight prices in USD across Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com and Traveloka, through the remote PriceWin MCP server (no account or API key), with a bundled travel-search skill.

entry.title: Han-1413141/dsh-autocompose
entry.summary: Find and compose DSH plugins from a task description, then open an independent chat environment or install the plan into the current profile.

entry.title: slow-stack/dsh-study-desk
entry.summary: Study workbench for exam prep and research: a three-column task board with tags and filters, a spaced-repetition queue (simplified SM-2) that keeps finished cards coming back, a heatmap lit by actual focused minutes, weekly reports, per-day review notes, a pomodoro timer that survives panel switches, and Markdown export/import for Obsidian.

entry.title: weibaohui/dsh-flow
entry.summary: Execution flow chart: renders the current session's execution as a vertical node flow (turns, user, assistant, tools, approvals, retries, compaction), appended in real time over SSE with auto-follow scrolling, so the chart draws wherever the session executes.

entry.title: weibaohui/dsh-thinktank
entry.summary: Think tank: a built-in library of 144 classic mental models (decision/strategy/cognition/psychology/communication/learning/system/innovation/execution) — enter one question and several selected models analyze it in parallel via AI, producing a synthesized report with consensus, disagreements, blind spots and an action checklist; supports both automatic analysis and prompt round-trip import.

entry.title: 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body
entry.summary: Organ-based plugin layer: plugins declare capabilities, senses and reflexes, a nerve impulse routes each command to the organ that owns it, reflex arcs fire with zero model calls, quiet periods consolidate run history into memory cards, and a failing organ heals through attribution, prescription and re-check.

entry.title: Han-1413141/dsh-compat-guardian
entry.summary: Detect DSH plugin conflicts and loading failures, quarantine affected bundles and recover them, with offline startup rescue.

entry.title: Han-1413141/dsh-pnpm-build-control
entry.summary: Control pnpm build-script approval across DSH profiles from Add Plugin, and repair same-Git-URL updates on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

entry.title: Han-1413141/dsh-visual-edit
entry.summary: Select elements, draw arrows or frame areas in DSH previews, send visual feedback to chat and compare before-and-after snapshots.

entry.title: Han-1413141/dsh-wsl-native
entry.summary: Use Windows and native Linux DSH sessions in one Windows window, with WSL environment switching and bidirectional system tools.

entry.title: weibaohui/dsh-ambient
entry.summary: White noise player: lays a layer of background sound (rain, streams, campfire, café…) while AI codes, helping you enter flow, stay focused and think efficiently, so you write code fast and well. Supports multiple playback modes (sequential / shuffle / single-loop / intermittent) and AI automatic background music download.

entry.title: weibaohui/dsh-fireworks
entry.summary: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes, with a welcome show, per-turn salutes, tool sparks, milestone celebrations, a finish finale and a dud on failure; each event type has its own fireworks card group with random variants, and token usage decides firework size, height and splendour.

entry.title: lcestou/dsh-oh-my-claude
entry.summary: Runs the logged-in Claude Code CLI as an LLM provider for dsh: live model list, per-session resume, approval relay, images, a memory/rewind/changes panel, and workspaces on remote SSH boxes.

entry.title: Bay-Zeddie/dsh-agent-instructions
entry.summary: Panel to edit dsh's native AGENTS.md from the web settings page: every layer in the instruction chain is clickable, three activation scopes, and a visual budget meter.

entry.title: Jovan1666/dsh-commandcode-quota
entry.summary: Command Code plan quota card in the DSH sidebar above Settings: 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as used percentages with reset countdowns, plus a /quota command and a zero-dependency CLI.

entry.title: BOWLUNA/dsh-custom-mode
entry.summary: Manage dsh agent modes from the settings page: choose a base composition, toggle plugin rows, and edit the system prompt (takes effect on the next model step).

entry.title: PerryLink/dsh-plugin-upgrade
entry.summary: One package, one corridor index: it reads the target repository peer band, routes to the matching closed upgrade corridor card, and runs a zero-dependency seam scanner, shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.

entry.title: weibaohui/dsh-kb
entry.summary: Team knowledge base for offline knowledge sharing (FDE box scenario): browse, full-text search and refinement entry points; raw material is queued automatically and distilled into wiki pages by a serial bot session (Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern: immutable raw, two-step refinement, log stream, monthly lint).

entry.title: weibaohui/dsh-file-share
entry.summary: Session workspace file manager: adds a "Files" tab to the conversation area to browse the current session workspace directory tree and manage it in place (upload, download, mkdir, rename, delete, search), with files mentionable into the composer for the agent to process.

entry.title: weibaohui/dsh-fde-tools
entry.summary: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks, auto-resume, UI tweaks, auto-retrospection, file manager, smart titles, task board, plugin market, context trimmer, IM bridge, sidebar enhancements), with a panel showing install status and one-click gap-filling.

entry.title: weibaohui/dsh-sync
entry.summary: Multi-machine sync: keeps multiple dsh replicas consistent through one private GitCode repository - skills, sessions, settings and plugin manifests each with an independent switch; changes go through branch, PR and merge, remote-only additions are pulled back before every push so nothing is deleted, and an AI smart-align step semantically merges files both sides changed (plus one-click conflict resolution); private repos enforced, pull never overwrites local edits.

entry.title: PerryLink/dsh-data-quality
entry.summary: Deterministic data profiling, cleaning, and verification: a ctx.dataQuality capability seam with three model tools and a frozen cross-plugin citation-checking contract — all computation in TypeScript, the model never does the math.

entry.title: PerryLink/dsh-fund-research
entry.summary: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds: every key number traces back to a hashed source snapshot — gaps declared, never invented; research only, not investment advice.
